laws.boundary_clipping: A bbox clipped by the scene-visible viewport is visible-output evidence, not authority for the hidden object's underlying trajectory/easing.
laws.projection_resolution: Linear interpolation of sparse measured keyframes is a renderer/evidence projection and cannot be promoted to original easing authority.
laws.source_lock: Frames classified SOURCE_LOCK may be measured for exact visible reconstruction but are excluded from reusable structural motion grammar unless independently proven editorial.
laws.transform_decomposition: Centroid translation, bbox size change, edge movement and visibility/reveal are separate observables; centroid motion alone cannot define object direction when bbox shape changes materially.

S04_CIENTIFICAMENTE.caveat: Tracks stop before the source phone transition; Graph Editor/easing remains unknown.

S11_UI_LIST.caveat: Visible bbox motion is authoritative for layout trajectory, not original easing or camera causality.

S14_AUDIO_VISUAL_TEXTO.caveat: Outgoing/incoming cards/headings repeatedly clip at screen boundaries; clipped visible bboxes must not be used to infer hidden-object easing.

S16_FACTOR_X.caveat: The editorial/source content viewport ends at y=1014; early column/Factor-X bboxes are bottom-clipped/revealed. Local87+ common upward reflow coincides with Reels UI reveal and is SOURCE_LOCK/causation UNKNOWN.
